My research interests lie at the intersection of differential geometry, spectral theory, and global analysis.

## Current research

### Spectral asymmetry of the Dirac operator on spherical 3-manifolds

My master's research concerns the spectral asymmetry of the Dirac operator on spherical three-manifolds. The project studies Dirac spectra on quotients of the three-sphere by finite groups acting freely and explores how group actions and spin structures influence spectral data.

Topics connected with this work include:

- Dirac operators and spinor bundles
- Spin structures on spherical space forms
- Finite group actions and representation theory
- Eta invariants and spectral asymmetry

## Research interests

I am also interested in differential topology, Clifford algebras, representation theory, and geometric constructions of Dirac-type operators.
